description: ONE SOUTH-EAST three-quarter head: make bangs MUCH FULLER and LONGER than current source, same approved short layered hairstyle. Continuous dense long diagonal fringe from crown down to just above eye line, cover MOST forehead including the large exposed triangular forehead gap.5-7 long tapered connected locks, fringe mass tracks turned forehead toward far temple. Match FRONT long-fringe identity rather than swept-up generic side-part. Both eyes remain visible, bangs end immediately above them. Low compact crown, tapered temples and short nape; do not enlarge head or change facing. Muted lavender-silver with violet shadows and restrained strand highlights. No tall spikes, exposed high forehead, curtains split in center, accessories or white bands. Keep face eyes ears mouth chin neck EXACT outside mask, head only transparent, no body. Complete strand tips.
